statements.text: Assessment: left lumbar radiculopathy at L3-L4 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
Past surgical history: no prior spine surgery.
MRI lumbar spine 08/20/2026: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline ODI prior to any intervention: 40%.
Symptoms began on 05/10/2026, 17 weeks before this visit.
Completed physical therapy from 05/22/2026 to 07/10/2026 (7 weeks) with no lasting benefit, and failed ibuprofen 600 mg TID.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
Epidural steroid injection history: 1 lumbar injection in the past 12 months (05/21/2026).
